messages:
omar-release: kicking off deploy for inference-runtime v2.3.1 now.
omar-release: plan is to enable feature flag `routing_v2` behind a staged ramp. targeting non-prod -> internal canary -> public ramp.
omar-release: rolling code is already on prod nodes, this is just the flag flip + pin model to `model@sha:ac12f3`.
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout started by omar-release for inference-runtime v2.3.1. canary group: team-internal (1% of traffic).
kevin-engineer: sgtm. I'll watch the 95p latency and error rate dashboards.
kevin-engineer: alert thresholds: if error_rate > 0.8% for 3m or 95p latency increase > 40ms for 5m we abort and rollback.
natalie-sre: adding synthetic tests and a short-run load test now. will post results in 5m.
sarah-ux: FYI this affects conversational routing only — UX experiments should be paused for this window.
ryan-eng: remind me—are we pinning the model variant for the canary?
omar-release: yes pinned to `model@sha:ac12f3` for the duration of the rollout. we won't auto-switch models during ramp.
kevin-engineer: curl toggle command I'm using:
```
# enable 1% canary
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/toggle 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_ADMIN' 
  -d '{"flag":"routing_v2","state":"on","rollout":{"group":"team-internal","pct":1}}'
```
ryan-eng: nice. after 1% and stable for 10m we go to 5% then 20/50/100 with 15m holler per step.
omar-release: correct — ramp cadence: 1% -> (10m) -> 5% -> (15m) -> 20% -> (15m) -> 50% -> (30m) -> 100%. total ~1.5-2h.
deploy-bot: [flag-change] routing_v2 enabled for group=team-internal pct=1 by omar-release at 2026-06-12T16:35:00Z
natalie-sre: load test looks clean so far. 95p latency +8ms, error_rate 0.15%. no regressions in logs.
kevin-engineer: canary metrics stable. advancing to 5%.
kevin-engineer: toggling to 5% now.
deploy-bot: [flag-change] routing_v2 updated for pct=5 by kevin-engineer at 2026-06-12T16:46:10Z
ryan-eng: quick note — we routed a subset of model=large-quant to fallback path; watch fallback count.
kevin-engineer: saw small bump in fallback_count but within expected. continuing.
sarah-ux: should we notify partners slack? small heads up to integrators channel post-50%.
omar-release: yes we'll announce at 50% and again at 100% in #general and integrators.
natalie-sre: at 20% we saw a slight spike in 95p (+22ms) but error_rate remained <0.3%. holding 15m then moving.
kevin-engineer: moving to 50% now.
deploy-bot: [flag-change] routing_v2 updated for pct=50 by kevin-engineer at 2026-06-12T17:28:31Z
ryan-eng: after 50% run we'll run a small A/B quality eval against golden prompt set.
kevin-engineer: running eval job qeval/route-check-20260612. results expected in 12m.
kevin-engineer: eval passed — diffs within tolerance. proceeding to 100%.
kevin-engineer: toggling to 100%.
deploy-bot: [flag-change] routing_v2 updated for pct=100 by kevin-engineer at 2026-06-12T17:41:05Z
omar-release: done. routing_v2 is live for everyone. pinned model remains `model@sha:ac12f3`.
ryan-eng: rolled notes for release: inference-runtime v2.3.1, flag routing_v2, model pin ac12f3. adding to release_notes/2026-06-12.md
sarah-ux: posting customer notice to #integrators now.
natalie-sre: monitoring window for full rollout: 1h. I'll escalate if SLOs degrade.
kevin-engineer: rollback play (if triggered):
```
# quick rollback to safe path
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_ADMIN' \
  -d '{"flag":"routing_v2","state":"off","reason":"auto-rollback:latency"}'
# pin model back to previous sha
rbctl set-model inference default model@sha:9f8e7d
```
omar-release: thanks team. great coordination. closing thread once h1 watch completes. :rocket:
ryan-eng: +1, nice ramp.
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout completed for inference-runtime v2.3.1 by kevin-engineer at 2026-06-12T17:41:10Z
